about: The Workbench icons of the Pacman3D drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/pacman3d.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: a yellow chomper on an isometric maze floor with dots) is The AmiCradle Team's own, MIT like the game; art/pacman3d.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. Pacman3D-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Pacman3D.info beside the drawer. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-Pacman3D.
